residency.test: Resident from the day of arrival with a permanent visa, from the day of arrival with a temporary work visa, or after 184 days of presence within any 12-month period on other visas.
residency.departure: Leaving requires a Declaração de Saída Definitiva do País. Without it you remain a Brazilian tax resident and stay liable to file and pay - this is the single most expensive mistake departing expatriates make.
residency.note: Brazilian residents are taxed monthly through carnê-leão or withholding, with an annual adjustment return.

headline.rates: 0% to 27.5% across five bands - the top rate arrives at a low income by international standards
headline.simplified_discount: a 20% standard discount capped at 16,754.34 replaces itemised deductions
headline.inss: progressive employee contribution from 7.5% to 14%, capped
headline.dividends: currently exempt in the hands of individuals, though reform proposals would change this

self_employed.note: 2% to 5% depending on the municipality and activity

capital_gains.general: 15% up to 5,000,000 of gain, rising in steps to 22.5% above 30,000,000
capital_gains.listed_shares: 15% on gains from share sales; monthly sales up to 20,000 on the exchange are exempt for individuals
capital_gains.property: 15% and up, with exemptions where the proceeds are reinvested in another Brazilian residential property within 180 days, and for a single property sold for up to 440,000
capital_gains.offshore: since 2024, income from offshore financial investments and controlled foreign companies is taxed annually at 15% regardless of distribution

quirks: Departing without filing the Declaração de Saída Definitiva leaves you a Brazilian tax resident indefinitely, with worldwide income still reportable. The exit declaration is separate from the annual return and has its own deadline.

Carnê-leão is a monthly self-assessment obligation for income received from individuals or from abroad - rent from a private tenant, or a foreign salary. It is paid monthly, not annually, and interest runs from each monthly due date.
Dividends from Brazilian companies are currently exempt for individuals, which is why many professionals operate through a company and pay themselves dividends rather than salary.

The choice between the simplified 20% discount and itemised deductions is made once per return and applies to everything. Large medical or education expenses usually favour itemising; nothing else does.
The 2024 offshore rules ended the old deferral on foreign investment funds and holding companies - offshore income is now taxed annually whether or not you bring it home.

reporting.portal: https://www.gov.br/receitafederal - Meu Imposto de Renda / e-CAC
reporting.who_must_file: Anyone with taxable income above roughly 33,888 in the year, exempt income above 200,000, gross rural income above 169,440, assets above 800,000 at year end, or who realised any capital gain or traded on the stock exchange.

documents_to_collect: CPF and a gov.br account, ideally at the gold or silver level
Informe de rendimentos from every employer, bank and broker
Full list of assets and rights held at 31 December with acquisition cost - the return is a wealth statement as well as an income return
Medical and education expense receipts if itemising
INSS and private pension (PGBL) contribution records
Records of every share and crypto transaction, with monthly totals

penalties.late_filing: 1% of the tax due per month, minimum 165.74 and maximum 20% of the tax
penalties.late_payment: 0.33% per day up to 20%, plus SELIC interest
penalties.omitted_income: 75% of the tax, rising to 150% where fraud is found
penalties.carne_leao: interest and penalty run from each monthly due date, not from the annual deadline

warnings: INSS bands are modelled as separate contributions; the effective annual cap on employee contributions is around 11,400.
The simplified discount and dependant deductions are mutually exclusive in reality - do not add both.
Municipal ISS and the presumed-profit company route used by many professionals (pejotização) are not modelled and change the picture substantially.
